prompt.task_description: You are given GD's 10-K filing for the quarter ending 2025-12-31. Extract and normalize the following financial metrics from the filing and XBRL data: revenue, operating_income, net_income, eps_diluted, total_assets, total_liabilities, stockholders_equity, operating_cash_flow, operating_margin, and ebitda. Report all monetary values in USD (unscaled). Use only information available as of the filing date (2026-01-30).
prompt.output_instructions: Respond with a JSON object containing a 'metrics' key mapping each metric name to its numeric value.
